environment.description: Same application containerized and deployed as a Pod in an EKS cluster (namespace: legacy-apps). A Kubernetes NetworkPolicy of type Egress is applied to the pod's namespace with a single allowed CIDR block of 10.0.2.50/32 on TCP port 389. However, the cluster also runs a Cilium CNI (v1.14) with CiliumNetworkPolicy resources that enforce L7 LDAP-aware filtering. The CiliumNetworkPolicy attached to the legacy-apps namespace specifies an L7 rule with 'l7proto: ldap' and a 'dns' section restricting search base to 'ou=employees,dc=corp,dc=local' with a filter pattern whitelist allowing only filters matching the regex '^\(&\(objectClass=(person|group)\)\((sAMAccountName|employeeID|cn)=[a-zA-Z0-9 ._-]+\)\)$'. Any LDAP search request whose filter contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9 ._-] in the attribute value position (such as *, (, ), |, \, NUL) is dropped at the network layer by Cilium's L7 proxy before reaching the LDAP server. The pod's ServiceAccount has no RBAC permissions beyond default.

config.runtime: EKS 1.28, Cilium CNI v1.14.2 with L7 policy enforcement
config.cilium_l7_action: DROP on non-matching filter patterns at proxy layer
